subject: Crestline: access boarding milestone plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Nicole Park <nicole.park@crestline.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crestline: access boarding milestone plan

Hi team,

Thanks for signing — Crestline has a Week 1 go-live target in the SOW. I wanted to kick off the access/seed plan so we have a clear milestone checklist for the implementation sprint. I attached the signed SOW for reference (crestline-signed-sow.pdf).

High level proposal:
- Day 0: confirm admin roster + target project name
- Day 1: seed service account + API key into their project (ephemeral key delivered via secure channel)
- Day 2: send user invites (admin + devs) and confirm RBAC mapping
- Day 4: ops kickoff (tenant routing, billing tags) + security walkthrough

Requests:
1) Monica — can you own invites and the user role matrix?
2) Karthik — can you handle key creation and the rotation plan (we should not email keys)
3) Nicole — please confirm the list of users and whether you need KMS-integrated keys (we have HSM/KMS options).

Attachments: crestline-signed-sow.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0191

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crestline: access boarding milestone plan

Ben — thanks for the plan. I'll take invites and the role matrix. I started an initial access matrix (attached) and filled in what I know. A couple of clarifying items before I send invites: 

- Do we want separate projects for prod / staging or a single project with namespaces? Nicole — quick preference here would help.
- For admin roles, confirm whether Crestline wants a "Platform Admin" + "Developer" split or also a separate "Billing Admin".
- I'll schedule the ops kickoff for Day 4; propose 60 minutes (technical) + 30 minutes exec sync.

Karthik — for seeding keys: we should use the service account pattern and place the private secret in the customer's KMS if they request it. I'll mark the matrix where I think each user belongs.

Attachments: initial-access-matrix.xlsx

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@crestline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crestline.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Crestline: access boarding milestone plan

Hi Ben / Monica / Karthik,

Thanks — excited to get started. A few answers from our side: 

- Preferred project name: crestline-production
- Admin roster (Platform Admins): Nicole Park (nicole.park@crestline.ai), Samir Khan (samir.khan@crestline.ai)
- Devs to invite (Developer role): lena@crestline.ai, owen@crestline.ai
- Billing admin: procurement@crestline.ai (please give Billing Admin only to this address)

Security notes: we require KMS-backed secrets for any long-lived keys. Short-lived service account tokens are fine if rotated daily. Can you send SOC2 Type II evidence and the network diagram prior to the security walkthrough? Also happy to run the ops kickoff on Jun 25th at 10am PT.

Procurement has the PO queued and will e-sign the DocuSign link (I copied them above).

Thanks,
Nicole Park
IT Lead, Crestline AI
nicole.park@crestline.ai
